name: saral
description: SARAL Protocol V3 — Separation-of-Powers Cryptographic Key Infrastructure

scripts.clean: rm -rf services/coordinator/bin services/saral-node/bin services/verifier/bin packages/*/dist apps/*/dist
scripts.build:go: go build -o services/coordinator/bin/coordinator ./services/coordinator/cmd/main.go && go build -o services/verifier/bin/verifier ./services/verifier/cmd/main.go && go build -o services/saral-node/bin/saral-node ./services/saral-node/cmd/main.go
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix apps/auth-server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:go && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:apps
scripts.dev: concurrently -n AUTH,WEB -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix apps/auth-server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:go
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f infra/compose/poc15.yml down && docker compose -f infra/compose/full24.yml down
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/auth-server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npx tsc -p packages/saral-sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit
